route.name: Aqaba Railway (Ma'an-Aqaba)
route.description: 1970s phosphate line to the Red Sea; freight ceased 2018
route.notes: Built 1975 on the Hejaz 1,050 mm gauge; operated by the Aqaba Railway Corporation from 1979.  [route] Ma’an to the Red Sea port of Aqaba, with a spur to the Shidiya phosphate mine (held as an off-line extra_station). Intermediate desert stations are not documented here.
route.history: A 1,050 mm narrow-gauge freight line built in 1975 by the Hejaz Jordan Railway from Ma'an to the Red Sea port of Aqaba to haul phosphate (from the Shidiya mine) and sulphur; the Aqaba Railway Corporation took over operations in 1979.
